summary: Completed frontend-only E2E testing of AMZ Prints ERP in mock mode. Login (admin/admin123), token persistence via reload, and all 9 module pages verified. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs (missing hook imports in Reports.jsx + missing /vendors and /purchases routes in App.js). After fixes: all sidebar modules navigate correctly, all data-testid selectors resolve, Vendors/Purchases/Order dialogs open, seeded invoices render, Settings tabs all switch cleanly, and no console/page errors during navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: PAGEERROR: 'useCallback is not defined' AND 'useMemo is not defined' — hooks were used inside the component but not included in the React import. Whole Reports page crashed into an Uncaught runtime error overlay (Error Boundary). FIXED by testing agent.

Routes for /vendors and /purchases were NOT registered inside <Routes>. Clicking Vendors/Purchases sidebar items fell through to the catch-all Navigate to /dashboard, making the two brand-new modules completely inaccessible via UI. FIXED by testing agent (imported components and added <Route> entries).

issues: Date range inputs use the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar — inconsistent with the design system used elsewhere.

action_items: Review other recently-refactored files for the same class of bug (hook used without being imported). We only found Reports.jsx, but E1 should audit any other files touched during the useCallback exhaustive-deps refactor.
Add an automated ESLint rule (react-hooks/rules-of-hooks + no-undef) to CI so this exact class of regression is caught before shipping.
Consider replacing native <input type="date"> pickers on Dashboard/Reports with the shadcn Calendar/Popover component for design consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx imported only { useState, useEffect } but used useCallback and useMemo — a hard runtime crash. Fix pushed.

App.js was missing route registrations for two newly added modules (Vendors, Purchases) even though the sidebar exposed nav links and the components existed. Whenever a new module component + sidebar link is added, App.js MUST be updated in the same commit. Fix pushed.

Sidebar.jsx exposes 15 links but App.js only wires up 13 modules — the mismatch is now resolved, but a lightweight test that iterates all sidebar links and asserts non-redirect to /dashboard would prevent this regression.

rca_of_the_issue: During the recent code-review refactor for exhaustive-deps warnings, Reports.jsx was updated to use useCallback + useMemo but the corresponding named imports were not added to the `import React, { ... } from 'react'` line — resulting in an immediate ReferenceError on component mount. Separately, when the Vendors/Purchases modules and Sidebar links were added, App.js was not updated to register the <Route> entries, so react-router's catch-all `<Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />` silently redirected users back to /dashboard. Reproduction: (1) log in as admin/admin123, (2) click Reports in sidebar → runtime error overlay before fix; (3) click Vendors or Purchases → URL flips to /dashboard before fix. Mitigation applied: added missing hook imports in Reports.jsx and registered both routes + component imports in App.js. Post-fix re-run: 100% of listed features passed with 0 console errors.
